import {expect, test, vi} from 'vitest'

vi.mock('./client.js')

test('a journey that stubs its world', () => {
  const onSend = vi.fn()
  const spy = vi.spyOn(console, 'error')
  vi.stubGlobal('fetch', onSend)
  vi.stubEnv('CONCIV_HOME', '/workspace')
  vi.unstubAllEnvs()
  vi.useFakeTimers()
  vi.advanceTimersByTime(10)
  expect(spy).toBeDefined()
})
